name: What should I prepare before contacting LineWork Development about a custom home project?
description: Prepare your desired aesthetic, functional needs, approximate budget, and property characteristics before discussing a custom home project.

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before contacting LineWork Development about a custom home project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before contacting us for a custom home project, it's helpful to gather initial thoughts on your desired aesthetic, functional needs, and approximate budget. Consider compiling inspiration images, a list of 'must-have' features, and any preliminary ideas for the number of rooms or square footage. Having a general understanding of your property's characteristics, such as lot size or existing structures, can also aid in our initial consultation. This preparation helps us understand your vision and provide a more accurate initial assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare your desired aesthetic, functional needs, approximate budget, and property characteristics before discussing a custom home project.
